thread:
Elaine K.: thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — quick thread to capture the security/privacy/compliance follow-ups we promised. i'll call out specific questions and tag leads. first ask: soc2 vs iso timeline and what evidence we need. second: vpc/private deployment ETA and networking requirements. third: audit log retention/export and who owns the evidence buckets. fourth: kms/byok and hsm plans. feel free to answer in short bullets.

Sanjay R.: short summary from leadership side — SOC2 readiness is on the roadmap targeting a formal audit window in Q3; ISO27001 scoping kicks off q2. private (vpc) GA planned for Q4 with early access in q3. KMS BYOK pilot targeted q2. handing over to @Devon and @AJ for specifics. :wave:

Devon M.: SOC2 details — we need control owners, evidence buckets, and a runbook for evidence collection. immediate asks:
- control owners assigned in the next 2 weeks (I can own infra controls)
- evidence collection: config snapshots, access logs, runbooks, and org policies
- retention: default 90d for interactive logs, archive to enterprise buckets for >1yr

Devon M.: for evidence export, our recommended quick-export (internal ops) is:
```
# export console audit logs to s3 (example)
aws logs create-export-task --task-name export-audit --log-group-name /redwood/console-audit --from $FROM --to $TO --destination redwood-audit-bkt --destination-prefix audits/ALLHANDS-1836
```
Adjust dates and destination. we'll add a documented script in the runbook.

AJ P.: VPC/private notes — networking requirements are: customer VPC peering or PrivateLink + optional VPN, route table updates, and NAT/egress rules. checklist for customers: CIDR, subnets, peering CIDR ranges, allowed egress to our control plane endpoints. Early access (partner pilot) in Q3; GA if no major blockers in Q4. for private control plane: we support customer-managed NAT and NACLs; IPSec VPN and AWS Direct Connect options on case-by-case.

AJ P.: also note: dedicated capacity customers -> you can pin models and we will expose per-route audit hooks. planning to document the network diagram and example terraform in the private docs.

Maria L.: quick question — what's the default audit log retention and how do enterprise customers request longer retention / cold archive? also confirm encryption: default keys vs BYOK.

Devon M.: default retention: 90 days hot, 365 days warm (rolled to cheaper store), archival to S3 available up to 7 years on request. enterprise plans can request archival to their own S3 (we'll export) or to our encrypted archive with access controls. encryption: by default we use Redwood-managed KMS keys. BYOK (customer-managed keys) pilot in q2; full HSM-backed key support targeted q3.

Product Lead: roadmap clarifying notes — SOC2 and BYOK are gated by completed evidence automation and key rotation APIs. to hit q2 pilot for BYOK we need two things: 1) KMS integration + rotation tooling, and 2) docs and onboarding flow for customers. we're on track but dependent on a couple infra PRs. can provide a canary list for EA.

Maria L.: thanks — will follow up with customer success on archival pricing tiers and contract language for SLAs and long-term storage.

Elaine K.: action items I captured: 1) Devon to own SOC2 control mapping and runbook (devon) 2) AJ to publish private deployment network diagram + terraform example (aj) 3) Product to publish BYOK EA sign-up (product lead) 4) Ops to document audit export script + default retention (opsbot)

ComplianceBot: action created — "SOC2 pre-audit checklist" assigned to Devon M., due 2026-05-01.

OpsBot: doc links for quick reference: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2-prep and https://docs.redwood.ai/private/vpc-setup (internal). will add the export script to the runbook this week.

Sanjay R.: appreciated — please add any follow-up Qs here. we should try to close the action items before the next leadership check-in. :thumbsup:

Devon M.: one more note on logs — we will start tagging audit events with `audit.scope` and `audit.correlation_id` to make evidence pull easier. adding that to the runbook.

AJ P.: ping me if anyone wants to join the private deployment early access program — we'll open a signup form next week.

Elaine K.: thanks all, closing the loop here. i'll update the all-hands notes with links to the runbook once Devon posts it. :sparkles:
